scripts.dev: concurrently -n "API,WEB,ML" -c "blue,green,magenta" "pnpm run dev:api" "pnpm run dev:web" "pnpm run dev:ml"
scripts.dev:docker: docker compose up -d db redis && concurrently "pnpm run dev:api" "pnpm run dev:web" "pnpm run dev:ml"
scripts.dev:api: cd artifacts/api-server && export PORT=5001 && pnpm run dev
scripts.dev:web: cd artifacts/streamflix && export PORT=5173 && pnpm run dev
scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
